text: APPROVE: The extracted helpers (`WorkspaceDirsByName`, `WorkspaceDependencies`, `IsTestInput`, `Under`, `ChangeFilterSite`) carry the original logic unchanged, including the same condition order and the inverted `reported.Add` check, and removing roughly 15 points of nested loops and boolean chains should bring `ChangeFilters` under 15. I could not build or run the analyzer here, so the build and the exact complexity score are unverified. The type names used in the new signatures (`JsInventory.Inventory`, `TestInvocation`, `CiChangeFilter`) are assumed rather than checked.
